records.title: Эни I — точильный круг
records.subject: A compact medieval hand-cranked GRINDSTONE on a chunky wooden A-frame, one broad grey faceted circular wheel, simple dark iron axle and short wooden crank, low trough underneath, one large sharpening file secured to its side. A single coherent smithing precision-tool module, about 0.9 m wide and 0.85 m tall, outside-facing wheel fully visible. The wheel is unpowered and dry, no flames or sparks. No anvil, weapons rack, roof, ground, text or heraldry.
records.prompt:
TRANSPARENT PNG GAME ASSET CUTOUT. Create a NEW isolated game prop concept that belongs EXACTLY to the artistic family of the attached reference props. Use the reference images ONLY as the style/material/shape vocabulary, not as a scene to extend. Thick irregular carved wood with large chamfered corners; warm honey and ochre timber; broad hand-painted brush strokes, simple large wood-grain strokes; chunky faceted forms with visibly painted colour planes and gently lightened worn edges. Dull dark iron fittings and a few oversized rivets; fabric is broad muted olive/oatmeal painted folds. Stylized grey-brown stones with large flat facets. This is a painterly fantasy game asset illustration, NOT a photorealistic PBR render. NO fine fabric weave, wood pores, photorealistic glass, dense scratches, excessive tiny clutter or black comic outlines. High clarity at the camp's overhead game camera: orthographic three-quarter view, camera 48 degrees above horizontal, about 35 degrees azimuth. Keep silhouettes and useful top surfaces unmistakable. One complete subject/coherent module only, centered with a clear 8% empty margin all around, fully visible without cropping. True transparent alpha background; absolutely no opaque background, checkerboard, ground plane, terrain plinth, cast shadow, vignette, text, labels, watermark, flags, banners, coats of arms, heraldry, emblems, runes or decorative symbols. Neutral diffuse material illumination, no directional cinematic lighting, bloom, rim light, external glow or visible light sources unless the subject is itself an actual lamp. Match the broad painted colour treatment and bevel scale of the original crate, fence and herbal table.

records.title: Эни III — стол переноса

Between trays a simple large hand press/vise and one pair of broad tongs attached to the rear edge. Below, one open bin with a few thick blade templates and a small dull metal core. All physical ordinary forge tools, no magic machine, runes, glow, gears or floating parts. No roof/canopy, light, ground, extra anvil or heraldry.

records.title: Походный стол
records.subject: A compact expedition preparation table, 1.6 m wide and 0.85 m deep, height 0.85 m. Heavy dark honey timber trestle legs, broad plank top reinforced at corners with dull iron. One LARGE light cream map covers the central two thirds of the top: just a few thick muted coast/route lines and a simple dot, absolutely NO writing or symbols. Beside the map one simple brass compass without letters, one rolled parchment secured by a leather strap, and two small corked opaque coloured flasks in a low two-hole wooden holder near the far corner. A single empty lower shelf. Tabletop fully exposed, no roof/canopy, no tall racks, no hanging lantern. The map must be the clearest focal surface at 48-degree camp view.
records.prompt: Edit ONLY the painted geography on the parchment in the FIRST image. Preserve the entire prop, exact wood/metal/materials, painterly style, position, camera, proportions, all surrounding props and transparent background. The SECOND image is the actual geography reference, NOT an environment to create. On the existing flat parchment replace the random continents with an accurately simplified plan of that reference: one much larger irregular WESTERN landmass on the left, one smaller elongated EASTERN landmass on the right separated by a clear channel, and the SMALL SOUTHERN ARCHIPELAGO below-right of the larger landmass. Keep the characteristic broad coastline outlines and relative placement. Paint simple muted olive-grey land and subdued dusty-blue sea on cream parchment, a few large restrained mountain/forest strokes, no detailed relief. Remove all flags, labels, names, heraldry, emblems and decorative border from the geography reference. The parchment remains a FLAT map surface, no miniature 3D landscape. Entire isolated prop cutout, truly transparent alpha outside it, no backdrop/glow/cast shadow.

records.title: Свёрнутая карта Пелага
records.subject: One sailor's rolled parchment map with a short wide leather map case resting against it, bound together as one low compact group. Large cream parchment roll 65 cm long, visibly curled broad ends, a short partially unrolled flap exposes a few thick muted blue-grey coastline strokes without any writing or symbols. Ochre-brown plain leather cylindrical case with broad carved seams, one strap and dull iron clasp. No compass, table, floor or other objects.
